entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B.
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The present revision petition has been filed by the petitioner against the order dated 09.02.2023, passed by learned Judicial Magistrate, Pilibangan, Dist. Hanumangarh, whereby the trial court framed the charges against the petitioner for offences under Sections 498A and 323 IPC.
Counsel for the petitioner submits that love marriage was taken place between the petitioner and the complainant about nine years ago and out of the wedlock, a son was born.
Counsel submits that the complainant has made false averment against the petitioner that he used to harass her for dowry.

Counsel further submits that after due investigation, police has filed the challan against the petitioner only for offence under Sections 498A & 323 IPC and exonerated the petitioner from offence under Sections 406 and 494 IPC.
Hence, the trial court has committed serious error in framing charge for the aforesaid offence against [2024:RJ-JD:2431] (2 of 3) [CRLR-1212/2023] the accused-petitioner.
Therefore, the order impugned deserves to be set aside.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has submitted that the order impugned is just and proper and does not warrant any interference from this Court.

sentences.text: I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the impugned order as well as material available on record.

It is well settled legal position that at the stage of framing charge for an offence against an accused only prima facie has to be seen whether sufficient grounds are available on record to proceed against him and even strong suspicion is enough to frame charge and at this stage of the proceedings,
evidence is not required to be analyzed, as it is required to be done at the final stage after trial.

It is also well settled that at this stage of the proceedings only the charge-sheet and evidence collected during investigation, which has been produced alongwith the charge- sheet, is required to be considered.

In the present case, complainant in her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. has specifically deposed that the petitioner used to harass her for dowry and in this regard, social meeting was convened on two or three occasion and in the said meeting, issues between the petitioner and complainant were resolved, but after some time, the petitioner again started to harass the complainant and also used to beat her and ousted her from the house.
The statement of the complainant was corroborated with the statements of witnesses namely Gurpreet Singh, Jagtar Singh, Parvindar Singh and other witnesses.

[2024:RJ-JD:2431] (3 of 3) [CRLR-1212/2023] The Police, after due investigation, has filed the charge-sheet against the petitioner for offence under Sections 498A & 323 IPC and thereafter the trial court framed the charge against the petitioner for the said offence.
In view of above, this Court is of the opinion that the trial court has not committed any error in framing the charges for offence under Sections 498A & 323 IPC against the petitioner.
The impugned order is just and proper and does not require any interference.
The revision, thus being bereft of any force, is hereby dismissed.
Stay application also stands dismissed.

(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 18-GKaviya/-
